tool_args.rationale: The endpoint-matched history gap and transient lag favor a coupled memory ODE. Acquire the additional trajectories before fitting its four parameters, then reconstruct each initial memory state from the irregular prefix using elapsed times rather than absolute timestamps.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter coupled memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot rows have similar switching histories and forecast horizons, so a good fit could still trade off the memory timescale against coupling strength.
It costs less and could help distinguish memory from a snapshot model, but it is not the trajectory batch needed to estimate the coupled dynamics.
Neither model uses the observed prefix, so neither can explain a response gap between endpoint-matched histories.
